source_refs.note: ii) Suffix: a main subheading of 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 41-41.

blocks.text: Suffix (naam ka aakhri hissa) do types ka hai:

items: Primary suffix, jise stem ya root ka suffix bhi kehte hain. Yeh batata hai ke parent chain saturated hai (an) ya unsaturated (en ya yn).
Secondary suffix, jise asal functional group ka suffix bhi kehte hain. Yeh compound ka family name (khandani naam) deta hai, maslan -ol, -al, -one.
